title: CMP, OCSP, PKIXTSP: Ensure unique dissector descriptions
description:
These dissectors have several variants all registered to the
media type table. Have unique descriptions, so that they can be
distinguished in the Decode As drop down menu, and possibly elsewhere.

We don't enforce unique descriptions in for FT_STRING tables yet,
but probably should.
